retrievalProfile.description: A sun-drenched, backlit photograph of a figure on a boat framed by a billowing American flag with high-contrast, hand-drawn display typography.
triggerTerms: backlit nautical photography with flag framing
summer boat lifestyle with distressed hand-drawn type
sun-flared ocean scene with patriotic elements
excludeWhen: dark or moody lighting is required
urban or indoor settings are requested
minimalist or clean sans-serif typography is the primary focus

recipe.visualDefinition: A central figure viewed from behind on a boat, framed by the red and white stripes of a large, translucent American flag catching the sunlight. The scene is characterized by intense backlighting, sparkling water reflections, and a warm, high-key color palette, topped with organic, distressed lettering.
coreVisualRelationships: The flag acts as a dynamic, translucent frame for the central subject.
High-intensity backlighting creates a silhouette effect on the subject's hair and water surface.
The hand-drawn display type contrasts with the clean, wide-tracked subtitle.
Warm orange and red tones in the flag harmonize with the golden hour sunlight.
coreInvariants: Translucent fabric framing the top and sides of the composition.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A medium-shot of a female figure centered in the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure's back and the bright sun reflection on the water.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the large display text, follows the curve of the flag down to the subject, and out toward the horizon.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The bright, overexposed sky and water surface provide high-key negative space.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep red and navy blue from the flag elements.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white for the primary typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value, high saturation in the reds, with blown-out highlights in the water.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Organic, irregular script with varying stroke widths.
letterConstructionRules: Rough, deckle-edged strokes suggesting a dry brush or chalk.
Lowercase 't' with an elongated, wavy crossbar.
Inconsistent x-height and baseline for a casual, hand-made feel.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'n' has a jagged, vertical terminal.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a raw, expressive display script with a clean, ultra-spaced geometric sans-serif.

preserve: Hand-drawn texture of the main title
Extreme letter spacing of the subtitle

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the organic, textured feel of the primary title.
Provides the necessary geometric clarity for the wide-tracked subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-key photograph from behind a person on a boat, looking out at a sunlit ocean. A large American flag billows in the foreground, its red and white stripes translucent and glowing with sunlight, framing the top and right side of the image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary title in a white, hand-drawn, distressed script at the top center. Below it, add a subtitle in a small, black, geometric sans-serif font with extremely wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the flag translucent and glowing?
Is the primary text visibly distressed and hand-drawn?
Is the subtitle tracking extremely wide?
Is the lighting high-contrast and backlit?

mustRedesign: Do not replicate specific celebrity likenesses

mustAchieve: Tactile, organic feel to the lettering
Sense of motion in the flag

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the white text is legible against the bright background.
Check that the flag stripes create a natural frame.
Verify the water has realistic specular highlights.
Confirm the subtitle is lowercase and widely spaced.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a backlit lifestyle photograph framed by a translucent textile with a duo of expressive hand-drawn type and minimalist geometric type.
